judgments.subject: review.episode.operational_state
judgments.conclusion: The current independent-review-state contract owns unfinished episode continuation, reviewer generation, remediation, replacement, uncertainty, and retirement state; it does not presently own a permanent concern-scoped review-result ledger.

judgments.subject: review.result_and_judgment_records
judgments.conclusion: A shared App Server review-result capability is the probable owner of immutable provider-neutral ReviewResult and ReviewJudgment semantics, adjacent to but distinct from unfinished episode state.

judgments.subject: review.provenance_navigation_projection
judgments.conclusion: Codebase Memory is the probable replaceable current-world projection and traversal provider after a bounded owner-isolated and generation-bound synchronization extension; it does not own canonical review meaning or semantic coverage validity.

judgments.subject: review.provenance_gap
judgments.conclusion: Missing review provenance or projection coverage may expose uncertainty or nominate work but cannot itself authorize reviewer activation or a review obligation.
